name: zsnd_fade_lists_register_shutdown_at_exit
description: zSndFadeLists::RegisterShutdownAtExit registers the fade-list shutdown callback with the CRT atexit provider.
known_limits: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs COFF byte comparison passed with zero unmasked mismatches after relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a39a0 pushes zSndFadeLists::ShutdownAtExit and calls the CRT atexit provider.
The native child-process smoke calls zSndFadeLists::Init, leaves both fade lists live with nodes, and verifies the child exits cleanly through the registered atexit shutdown path.
